name: 5D Powers for Divi
author: divipowers

sections.description:
5D Powers for Divi adds powerful interactions, editable layouts, basic funnels, and optional administrator-started AI tools to the Divi 5 Visual Builder. Your pages remain native Divi pages that you can continue editing normally.

Free includes:

  • Dismissible elements, triggers and targets, drawers, modals, tooltips, content switching, and scroll navigation
  • Mailchimp tags for native Divi Email Optin modules
  • A native Builder workspace for written AI prompts, full pages, new sections, selected elements, and Power Map
  • A copyable mockup-to-Divi workflow guide for use in the AI service of your choice
  • Validated staged changes, exact approvals, WordPress revisions, activity history, and rollback
  • Native Divi 5 layouts, Design Library patterns, downloads, presets, variables, and a starter page
  • Unlimited basic editable funnels, three WooCommerce checkout layouts, and Commerce Utilities
  • Current-user shortcodes, admin-bar links, a shared dashboard, and onboarding

5D Powers for Divi Pro is a separate add-on for visual funnels, WooCommerce checkout journeys, order bumps, conditional checkout tools, validation, analytics, and site-wide auditing.

Developed independently by 5D Creations. Divi is a trademark of Elegant Themes; this plugin is not affiliated with or endorsed by Elegant Themes.

External services

  • DiviPowers.com supplies disabled-by-default online design and model catalogs plus optional design downloads. Catalog requests send server IP, plugin version, and HTTP metadata; the model catalog receives no key, prompt, or page. Remote previews can send browser IP, referrer, user agent, and HTTP metadata. Downloads send the asset URL; licensed Pro downloads also send the license key, installation ID, site URL, and Pro version. Disabling a catalog stops requests and ignores cached online entries. Service website, Terms of Service, and Privacy Policy.
  • OpenAI supplies optional model discovery and Builder AI proposals at api.openai.com. Testing/listing sends the administrator’s key, server IP, and HTTP metadata, but no prompt/page. A prompt also sends model, prompt, page ID/title/hash/content, optional selection, and layout instructions. Both synchronous and background requests set OpenAI’s store field to false. Long-running full-page and section builds use background mode, which still stores response data temporarily so this site can poll for completion; OpenAI currently documents that temporary polling period as roughly ten minutes. The key is encrypted or supplied by a server constant and is not exposed to the Builder. Provider charges may apply. Services Agreement, Data controls, and Privacy Policy.
  • Mailchimp supplies audience tags, subscription/update, and tagging through the data center configured in Divi. Opening the Builder can send the credential and audience ID to list tags. Submitting a configured Email Optin sends email/form data through Divi; Divi Powers sends credential, audience ID, MD5 subscriber ID, names when updating, selected tags, and a membership-status lookup. The site owner controls the form, notice, and consent. Terms and Intuit Privacy Statement.
  • tawk.to supplies optional admin support chat. Its script loads only after Open Support Chat is clicked and receives browser metadata, hostname, theme and platform/plugin versions, support tags/screen, an opened event, and entered text. A direct-chat fallback sends browser metadata when opened. The local report is sent only if manually pasted. Terms and Privacy Policy.
  • Google Analytics can receive optional funnel events only through a separately installed Google tag when analytics is enabled for that step. Events contain the event name and funnel/step IDs, names, types, labels, position, entry/goal state, and optional test flag; Divi Powers adds no name, email, form, or payment data. The Google integration controls measurement/consent and may collect normal browser, device, and session data. Terms and Privacy Policy.

Mockup workflow

How do I build from a mockup?

Mockup uploads are currently unavailable in Builder AI. Open the copyable workflow guide in the Builder, then use its prompts manually in the AI service of your choice. Create image and icon assets separately, build editable native Divi modules, and complete responsive QA before publishing. No external service can call back into the Free plugin to administer the site.

Source code

Plugin PHP, JavaScript, CSS, and JSON sources are included. The bundled html2canvas 1.4.1 distribution is MIT-licensed; its upstream source and build scripts are available. See THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.txt and assets/vendor/html2canvas/LICENSE.
sections.installation:
Upgrading from Powers for Divi: if Pro is installed, make sure it is already 0.22.7 or newer. Install and activate 5D Powers for Divi 0.23.7, then update Pro to 0.34.0. Activation deactivates the former Lite directory and preserves existing settings and content. Keep the old inactive files while checking any legacy asset URLs.

Upgrading from the former divi-powers directory: back up the site, then install and activate 5D Powers for Divi. Activation deactivates the old copy while preserving settings, funnels, and layouts. Keep the inactive files until existing content no longer references their asset URLs. Network-active installations must be migrated by the network administrator.

  1. Upload the 5d-powers-for-divi folder to /wp-content/plugins/, or upload the plugin ZIP through Plugins > Add New.
  2. Activate 5D Powers for Divi.
  3. Open Divi Powers > Getting Started.
  4. Install the Divi starter page, open it in the Visual Builder, or insert a ready-made Design Library pattern.
  5. Open Divi Powers > Help & Support to search the knowledge base, submit a ticket, share feedback, use configured live chat, or copy a local system report.

Open Divi Powers > Builder AI to add your own OpenAI API key for administrator-started written prompts inside the Visual Builder. AI Engine is not required. Every generated layout is staged for review and requires its exact approval phrase; a WordPress revision and protected rollback are created before saving. The Free plugin does not expose a remotely callable site-administration endpoint.
sections.faq:
When is an OpenAI API key needed?

Only when you choose to run AI prompts directly inside the Divi Visual Builder. The optional key is encrypted before it is stored in WordPress and is used only for administrator-started server-side requests. All other Free features work without it.

Does a Divi Powers AI prompt immediately change the page?

No. Builder AI sends the saved page, request, and optional selected-element details to OpenAI, then stages a validated proposal. The page stays unchanged while you review the summary and diff. Applying requires the job’s exact approval phrase, a fresh page-hash check, and a WordPress revision.

Where are long-running Builder AI jobs stored?

While a long-running job is active, its prompt, saved page content, status, and optional mockup files are temporarily stored in a secret-derived directory inside the WordPress uploads folder. The plugin adds Apache and IIS deny rules and directory-index guards, limits file sizes, and schedules the job directory for deletion one day after the job begins. WordPress runs scheduled cleanup when the site receives traffic.

Do I still need the separate Divi Powers Plus plugin?

No. The former Plus funnel, checkout, and Commerce Utilities are built into Divi Powers Free. Existing Plus records and option keys are reused in place, so the separate Plus add-on can be deactivated and removed after this version is active.

What information leaves my site?

Activation sends no telemetry. Local interactions, bundled designs, local funnel counts, and the copyable AI workflow guide work without an external service. Optional requests are disclosed below.
sections.changelog:
0.23.7

  • Sanitizes legacy WooCommerce return paths before comparison and keeps request data out of filtered home URLs.
  • Fixes Free funnel install and rebuild requests launched from Getting Started.
  • Makes bundled starter-page admin links work on subdirectory WordPress installations.
  • Hides the prompt-only input from confirmation dialogs.

0.23.6

  • Replaced blocking native confirmations and prompts with an accessible, focus-managed plugin dialog.

0.23.5

  • Updates the bundled starter-funnel copy to use current Design Library terminology.
  • Ensures tooltip and popover width settings override Divi’s generated row sizing.
  • Clarifies that live support chat appears only when it has been configured.

0.23.4

  • Updates the bundled starter tour to link directly to the Design Library with current wording.

0.23.3

  • Rewrites the customer-facing admin pages with clearer, consistent Free terminology and action labels.
  • Replaces the upgrade tier summaries with an accessible Free-versus-Pro feature comparison.
  • Clarifies Builder AI privacy, OpenAI billing, support-data handling, checkout setup, and Design Library bulk actions.
  • Updates the included starter page and example funnel copy to match the current Free feature set.

0.23.2

  • Prepares the assigned WooCommerce product and checkout-profile cart behavior before a starter-funnel route redirects to checkout.

0.23.1

  • Stores long-running Builder AI jobs in secret-derived physical directories and adds Apache/IIS access guards plus bounded cleanup of prior job paths.
  • Restricts online designs and previews to approved HTTPS hosts, caps catalog/download sizes, and rejects additional active HTML elements before installation.
  • Adds bounded, no-redirect OpenAI and Mailchimp requests and complete dialog semantics for modal presentations.
  • Limits automatic repairs and historical data migration to authorized administrators.
  • Stops local funnel event recording for unpublished pages, paused funnels, and steps whose analytics setting is disabled.
  • Carries forward Pro reliability fixes for journey cart isolation, funnel drag ordering, copy fallback, and drawer focus.

0.23.0

  • Removed the remote MCP transport and OAuth site-impersonation layer from the WordPress.org package; optional remote connectivity is now owned only by the separately distributed Pro add-on.
  • Replaced the custom checkout wrapper with WooCommerce’s native checkout shortcode and migrated existing generated pages automatically.
  • Escaped the remaining user-facing shortcode output according to its HTML context.
  • Added categorized admin navigation, a searchable Feature Manager, and separately dismissible page overviews from the newer Pro interface.
  • Preserved administrator-selected page templates while repairing or migrating generated starter and funnel pages.
  • Updated the plugin directory and Pro dependency metadata for the 5d-powers-for-divi WordPress.org slug.

0.22.8

  • Align interface branding with 5D Powers for Divi and 5D Powers for Divi Pro.
  • Remove obsolete beta product labels while preserving the optional Beta update channel.

0.22.7

  • Renamed to 5D Powers for Divi, with a safe handoff from prior plugin directories.
  • Enabled checkout-step duplication and multiple checkout steps with separate profiles.
  • Moved Builder configuration and consent-screen styling to WordPress asset APIs.
  • Filtered private preview HTML and block attributes before rendering.
  • Migrated owned funnel and checkout profile types without changing record IDs.
  • Removed bundled-design license gates; paid remote catalogs belong to the separate Pro add-on.

screenshots.caption: The 5D Powers dashboard brings the Free toolkit, setup paths, funnels, and support into one organized workspace.
Guided setup verifies Divi 5 readiness and installs an editable interactive starter page and example funnel.
The Design Library adds ready-made Divi pages, sections, rows, and modules directly to the native Divi Library.
Basic funnels connect editable landing, offer, checkout, and thank-you pages with WooCommerce products and launch checks.
Builder AI uses the administrator's own OpenAI API key to stage reviewable Divi changes inside the Visual Builder.
The included starter page demonstrates a real focus-managed modal and other interactive Divi behaviors on the front end.
